findings.reason: the clear must be gated to an explicitly supplied root_paths (or routed through a root-scoped entry on the reset owner) so default startup does not re-expand roots it never asked to reset.
findings.text: §14 puts the expanded_at clear on the seed item built for every canonical root, so it fires for config-driven seeding too (the default caller seed_facility_roots(facility) at imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:2857), not only for an explicitly requested `--root`; every discovery run would then re-expand all 17 roots and re-list their children on each invocation, and the clear is a second owner beside PATH_RESET_SPECS, which the plan itself names as the owner of reprocessability

findings.reason: the owner of the rendered join should be named honestly and, given the writer lives at imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:522, the plan should justify siting a traversal renderer in the vector-search module or move it to where the edge is written.
findings.text: §19 justifies siting the new source-resolution helper by claiming vector_search.py "already owns the rendered Cypher helpers the three sites call", but the file contains a single function, build_vector_search, that emits only the MATCH+SEARCH prefix with no join or RETURN, and two of the five named readers (imas_codex/llm/server.py:827 and imas_codex/graph/schema_context.py:95) inline their own CYPHER 25 SEARCH rather than calling it, so the proposed renderer is a new concern (relationship traversal plus coalesce) placed in a SEARCH-syntax module on a thinner reuse precedent than the plan states

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §19's single parameterised renderer in imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py hides the HAS_CHUNK edge name and the source coalesce behind one call embedded by all five divergent sites, and §14 extends two existing functions rather than adding a wrapper.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 clears expanded_at in seed_facility_roots in addition to extending the reset owner PATH_RESET_SPECS (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:240), and the seed runs for every configured root, not only the explicitly requested one.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — the supplied counts are public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §19 states in its own text "Interface budget: nothing added" and §14 adds no CLI option or view, reusing `discover paths --root` and the existing reset specs.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §19 names the mechanism it extends, but its citation that imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py "already owns the rendered Cypher helpers the three sites call" is inaccurate: the module holds one MATCH+SEARCH prefix builder that renders no join or RETURN, and two of the five readers it must cover do not call it.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — neither new section introduces a forwarding layer over existing machinery; §14 extends seed_facility_roots and PATH_RESET_SPECS in place and §19 collapses five readers onto one rendered fragment.
